whatIsIt.eli5: Turns the map into a list of pixels, lets the groups work, and turns it back into a map.
whatIsIt.simple: Flattens the map into tokens (one per pixel), runs adaptive hypergraph convolution, reshapes back.

whyExists.eli5: The group finder works on a list of pixels.
whyExists.simple: Hypergraph operations act on sets of vertices (pixels).
